messages:
alex: FYI: scheduling a minimal-base-image rebuild this Thu 08:30 PT. Goals: remove CAP_NET_RAW, enable userns remap, and ensure signed artifacts via cosign. Also changing keystore envelope keys to per-cluster KMS keys.

nina: timeline ok. are we doing a hard cut or rolling canary?

alex: rolling canary. start with internal-canary -> staging -> prod-canary -> fleet. ~15m per step with automated health checks.

carter: important: RBAC prune first. bake-runner SA still has cluster-admin in a few namespaces. need a migration script to narrow to only bake jobs.

sasha: +1. please include an audit annotation on the RBAC objects so SOC can track the change. e.g., `metadata.annotations['sec.redwood/audit']=SEC-5122`.

nina: KMS question: switching envelope KEKs per-cluster means new KMS aliases. who will create and grant keystore-operator the kms:Decrypt and kms:Encrypt on the new keys?

alex: infra will pre-create keys. Carter will own granting roles for keystore-operator. we will use a CI step to test access.

carter: incident path: if keystore-operator fails to rewrap, we need fallback to decrypt with old KEK. runbook item: `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=enc --key=projects/.../old-keystore-key`. sasha: add to runbook?

sasha: done. also adding step to create a short-lived admin impersonation token and restrict to oncall in the runbook.

alex: audit logs: legal wants WORM retention 1y. plan: write logs to WORM bucket, encrypt with cluster KEK, add manifest with cosign-signed provenance for each batch. ops-bot: created ticket SEC-5122 for WORM retention + manifest schema.

nina: how do we attest that images were rebuilt reproducibly? add SBOM generation + cosign attestation to pipeline.

carter: build pipeline snippet for attestation:
```
buildctl build ... --output type=image,name=registry/redwood/base:sha
syft packages -o cyclonedx=json > sbom.json
cosign sign-blob --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign sbom.json
kubectl create secret generic sbom-redwood --from-file=sbom.json
```

sasha: post-deploy checks:
1) cosign verify --bundle -key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign registry/redwood/base:sha
2) sysctl check: `sysctl -a | grep userns` or verify writable flags on /proc/sys/net
3) verify capabilities dropped in running pods

alex: rollout checklist (will attach to SEC-5122): [ ] RBAC PR merged and annotated, [ ] keys provisioned, [ ] cosign key rotated and tested, [ ] canary windows scheduled, [ ] SBOM + attestation pipeline green, [ ] runbook attached.

ops-bot: reminder: add 30m pre-cutover ping to #release-war-room.

nina: small edge: legacy debug sidecar still needs CAP_NET_RAW for pcap capture. plan: move to a debug-daemonset in a restricted node pool rather than granting it to app pods.

carter: test commands for the oncall/rollout team:
```
# confirm capabilities dropped
kubectl get pod -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].securityContext}' | grep CAP_NET_RAW || echo OK
# verify KMS decrypt works with new KEK
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=redwood --key=cluster-eu-1 --ciphertext-file=sample.enc --plaintext-file=-
# cosign verify
cosign verify --bundle -key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign registry/redwood/base:sha
```

sasha: post-mortem trigger: if more than 3 failed rewrap attempts across clusters or >30m downtime for any bake pipeline, open an incident and attach timeline to SEC-5122.

alex: owners: RBAC/Carter, KMS/infra (carter infra-sig), Artifact signing/nina, runbook/sasha. I'll post final owners + links in ticket today.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: [ ] RBAC PR, [ ] keys created, [ ] build+attest green, [ ] cosign signer verified, [ ] canary schedule, [ ] runbook added to SEC-5122.

nina: I'll take cosign signer rotation and verify attestations in CI by 4pm PT.

carter: I'll prepare RBAC migration PR and add audit annotations. pairing with alex 2pm.

alex: thanks everyone — will put a 30m heads-up and monitor #eng-oncall during the canary. :shield:
